My dog ate chocolate — what do I do?
Small amounts of milk chocolate are usually fine for big dogs, but dark chocolate is dangerous. Tell me roughly how much and their weight — and if they're vomiting, call your vet now.
How often should I trim my cat's nails?
Every 2–3 weeks for most indoor cats. Trim just the clear tip and give a treat after!
Is it normal for my rabbit to eat its droppings?
Yes! Those soft 'night droppings' are packed with nutrients. Totally normal and healthy.
